name: Pulse Biosciences, Inc.
summary: Pulse Biosciences, Inc. operates as a novel bioelectric medicine company. It offers nPulse System, a novel Nanosecond Pulsed-Field Ablation delivery platform to treat benign lesions of the skin; nPulse Vybrance Percutaneous Electrode system for soft tissue ablation in surgical setting; nPulse Cardiac Surgical Clamp designed for use in surgical treatment of atrial fibrillation (AF); nPulse Cardiac Catheter System designed to provide a circumferential, or circular, ablation in a single treatment cycle; and nPulse Console, a software-enabled console-based platform designed to accommodate the clinical workflow preferred by physicians.
